event_name: Georgia: Landslide/Wet mass movement - Imereti (Khemaghali & Ghverki) - 26/05/2025
locations_name: Ghverki, Raion Kharagauli, Imereti, Georgia; Khedmaghali, Raion Kharagauli, Imereti, Georgia
description: Georgia: 239 displacements (evacuated), 26 May - 18 September. According to local officials, around 70 households have left the villages of Khemaghali and Ghverki, Imereti, Georgia, due to landslides. This impacts approximately 239 individuals. Democracy & Freedom Watch - 18 September 2025
